title: Government Code, Title 2, Division 3, Part 2.8 (Civil Rights Department) - California Family Rights Act, §12945.2
verified_how: Fetched the GOV Title 2 Div 3 expanded branch: 'PART 2.8. CIVIL RIGHTS DEPARTMENT 12900-12999', Ch 6 Art 1 12940-12954. Fetched §12945.2: amended by Stats. 2022, Ch. 748 (AB 1041), effective 1 Jan 2023.
notes: Job-protected family and medical leave (CFRA). Pregnancy disability leave is §12945. Part 2.8 is the Fair Employment and Housing Act.
